en: <F4><I0>00 receives a bonus ball<FG>
You've got to beat Fractos<FG> You have to<FG>
The ruins of the castle lie in the north-west of the wilds. You have the power to banish the darkness<MV>I know it<FG>
You're going to fight Fractos, are you<FH> Be careful<MV>the darkness has given him inhuman powers...
Are you the ones looking for a way into the Black Manse<FH>
<F4><I0>00 receives a princess's orb<FG>
How it must have pained poor Unos to see his world devastated... Please<MV>you must put an end to Fractos's evil<FG>
The palace fell from the sky into the north-western part of the wilds. The teleportal to the Black Manse may still be intact...
So Fractos has returned to the other world... I can scarcely believe it...
Sir<FG> I've finished my two hundred squats, sir<FG> What's next, sir<FH>
Goowee<FG> Amaz<MV> I mean, not bad, maggot<FG> Alright, next<MV>
Oh, relax<FG> The whole mess has been sorted out now<FG> The High King's pardoned you, and the King of Harba forgave you too<FG>
And besides...something awful had happened to you. You weren't yourself. I still can't imagine who would have done such a thing...
About that... We think there might be someone who can tell us more...
What<FH> Really<FG><FH>
The crown I wear was presented to me some years ago<MV>by the Queen of Ingenia, in the eastern forests.
The Queen of Ingenia<FG><FH>
Indeed. The feathers that adorn it can only be found in that kingdom, and even there, they are a rare and precious commodity.
What's more, the Queen is one of the world's greatest sorceresses. No spell is beyond her powers...not even Morph...
Are you playing drill sergeants again<FH> Careful you don't wear poor Ruff out before the party even starts<FG>
I'm fine<FG> This'll be the first big party I've ever been to<FG> I'm too excited to sit still, so a bit of training's just what I need<FG>
Ha ha<FG> You and Healix were made for each other<FG>
You must be the ones who hope to do battle with Fractos<FG> May this aid you in your quest...
<F4><I0>00 receives a champion's choker<FG>
I failed to leave so much as a scratch on Fractos's vile hide... Oh, the shame... You must do what I could not, and defeat him<FG>
You wish to find Unos's palace<FH> Yes, it fell to earth here... Struck from the sky by the Dreadbolt a thousand long years ago...
Sometimes I see a strange light shimmering at the edge of these wilds... Will I ever find out what it is...<FH>
Oho<FG> It seems you have mastered the ways of both warrior and martial artist. I believe you may be ready to walk a road less travelled...
This is the place. What's left of it, anyway... Traders used to use it as a staging post. I ordered the soldiers to send everyone here.
It's been disused for quite some time, but some of the evacuees have made themselves at home already.
That High King o' yours sure ain't as sweet as he looks, huh<FH> And how come there's two o' the little guy all of a sudden<FH>
Well, he didn't split himself in half, did he<FH> He clearly had a twin all along<FG> Now, would someone mind explaining what's going on<FH>
‘Should ever wicked war resume,\nA dragon shall the sun consume,\nAnd sibling souls be born as once before...
‘But till the land be steeped in blood,\nMay sovereign twins, however good,\nNe'er hope to rule in peace forever more.’
Well, I don't know about the dragon part, but we've had the war...and now we've got twin kings as well...
Could the High King and his brother be the twin sovereigns from the prophecy<FH>
We will not find that out by standing here speculating. We need to act. We need to take back the city<FG>
First, we clear the monsters from the streets and rescue those left behind. Then, we go to the Pinnacle. And there...we face them...
A most astute plan<FG> However, it will surely require a means of dispersing this dark power that renders monsters impervious<FH>
Well, before we start thinking about that, the first thing we need to do is rest. It's been a long day...
I shall leave the instructions for a certain task with the questmistress. Complete it, and a new path will be opened up to you.
Oho<FG> It seems you have mastered the ways of both priest and mage. I believe you may be ready to walk a road less travelled...
I shall leave the instructions for a certain task with the questmistress. Complete it, and a new path will be opened up to you.
I have a task for you<MV>'tis the perfect opportunity for an aspiring hero such as yourself to prove <EK>00his<EL>00her<EM>00 worth.
<F4><I0>01 receives a mini medal<FG>
Still, it would seem your quest for greatness proceeds apace<FG> Here, take this<MV>consider it a token of goodwill from a fellow glory-seeker.
<F4><I0>01 receives a chronocrystal<FG>
Take this, I prithee. The path to glory is long and treacherous<MV>may it serve you well on your journey<FG>
<F4><I0>01 receives a witch's orb<FG>
Perhaps it even rivals my own... Here, take this<MV>consider it a token of our new-found fellowship.
<F4><I0>01 receives a bondstone<FG>
From now on, we are no longer firm friends, but fierce rivals<FG> Take this<MV>if you mean to achieve greater glory than I, you may need it<FG>
<F4><I0>01 receives a wizard's orb<FG>
Here, take this<MV>a token of our eternal rivalry<FG> Should you cease your travails even for an instant, it will be my name on Accordian lips<FG>
<F4><I0>01 receives a mythic beast bone<FG>
I still can't quite believe it... I've served him for so many years... How could I never have known he had a twin...<FH>
I was so convinced he was a shining example to all men... Seems I never really knew him at all...
Oh, Desdemona...
But don't you think it's a bit suspicious that not even you noticed the High King had a twin brother<FH>
Yeah... And how did they manage to keep it a secret<FH> They'd have to have been doing it since they were born.
I had wondered the same thing. It would have been almost impossible for someone not to have found out by now.
Well, perhaps we'll know more once we've cleared away the Cover of Darkness and taken back the city...
Allow me to offer you a gift in recognition of your eminence. 'Tis the least a hero such as yourself deserves.
<F4><I0>01 receives an orbus regale<FG>
Prithee accept this humble gift, <EK>00milord<EL>00milady<EM>00. I look forward to seeing what wondrous heights your renown will reach next<FG>
<F4><I0>01 receives a spatter of molten globules<FG>
Take this, I prithee. 'Tis a humble token of the reverence in which I hold you.
<F4><I0>01 receives a warrior's ring<FG>
Oi<MV>you ain't 'eard this from me, right, but that old orb-seller fella's got somefink extra special in stock.
Fing is, 'e won't even let you look at it unless you got the right qualamifications. Cor, I don't 'alf wish I 'ad 'em...
Wh-What's going on<FG><FH>
The door opens<FG>
Such rash behaviour is hardly becoming of a king.
Guardians of the Tomb<FG> I, a scion of Dunis and member of the royal line, would know the secrets of this holy place<FG>
......Lies<FG> You would plunder the secrets of this holy place<FG> The jewel will not be yours<FG>
What did y<MV> I said, I am a scion of Dunis, and member of the royal l<MV>
IF YOU WISH...TO CLAIM...THE SECRETS<MV>BZZT<FG><MV>you must<MV>BZZT<FG><MV>YOU MUST<MV>BZZT<FG><MV>DEFEAT US<FG>
Hey... You know that cup the High King was holding when the monsters attacked<FH> Didn't we see the same one in the throne room<FH>
I thought the same thing. But the one I remember wasn't quite so...creepy...
That was the Cup of Kings. It's a sacred vessel of light that's been in the Accordian royal family since ancient times.
Wait, you mean the same cup that Fractos cursed and used to start the war a thousand years ago<FG><FH>
Full marks. And now it seems it may have been cursed all over again...
The legends say that the cursed cup fed on wrath, spite and sorrow to summon up terrible, dark powers.
I wonder if that might be what made the monsters turn on us...and what made them so strong...
But what about Healix<FH> He's a monster, but the cup hasn't done anything to him.
I'm not sure. Maybe he's just more strongly attuned to the light than other monsters.
You see, most monsters are easily influenced by the power of darkness, but some of them are powerfully resistant to it.
Really<FH> So there's more to our little friend than meets the eye, eh<FH> And...who was it who cursed the Cup of Kings, exactly<FH>
It must have been the High King. Maybe he was tempted by the power of darkness just as Fractos was so long ago... Or maybe...
What is it, Desdemona<FH>
Never mind. Now's not the time. We need to think of a way to take back Accordia<MV>and fast<FG>
Monsters in disguise, eh<FH> Well, that's not very sporting. And it looks like all that time alone down here has driven them a little potty...
Then we'll just have to knock some sense back into them<FG> Here they come, everyone<FG>
BZZT<FG> YOU MUST DEFEAT US<FG> BZZT<FG>
Well, we beat them, just like they asked us to. I feel a little sorry for them, to be honest...
Huh<FH> How's about that<FH> Seems our pals left us a li'l somethin'<FG>
Arey<FG> It's beautiful<FG> Oh, look how it shines<FG> Imagine how much it must be worth<FG>
So the Heart of Brightness was here after all. It can't be anything else<MV>just look at it. The Cover of Darkness won't stand a chance.
Yoy<FG> This is truly a fortuitous discovery<FG> We must march promptly on Accordia, and proceed with dark-banishing without delay<FG>
I admire your enthusiasm, but we should probably head back to the encampment and make sure we're good and ready first.
Sounds like a plan<FG> Come on, let's grab the Heart of Brightness and get back to camp<FG>
He gathered the rulers of the Seven Realms on the pretence of celebration, when in truth he meant to kill them and take their kingdoms...
Yeah... With friends like the High King, who needs enemies, eh<FH> Seriously, though<MV>is Dunisia going to be okay<FH>
How many times<FH> Donk will retake the realm. He is a shrewd and capable commander. Far shrewder than some I could mention...
And have we heard how the efforts to retake the other realms are progressing<FH> Those other than Accordia, I mean...
Not yet. But we'll take back Accordia soon enough. The High King isn't fit to rule it any more, and those people need our help<FG>
The party acquire the Heart of Brightness<FG>
Alriiight<FG> Now we can finally tear into those monsters and send them packing<FG>
I think we probably need a slightly better plan than that. The western part of the city here seems relatively quiet, doesn't it, Cesar<FH>
It does. We must establish a foothold here, and then fight our way further into the city. Everyone<MV>forward<FG>
The auld encampment had its charms, to be sure, but it's a relief to be back in Accordia. I'm too old to be sleepin' out under the stars<FG>
You're not actually thinking of climbing all the way to the top of that enormous tower, are you<FH> ...Are you<FG><FH>
Aoooooo<FG> Healix says if I make it through his training, I'll be a living, breathing weapon of war<FG> I can't wait<FG>
The girl vanishes in a flash of blinding light<FG>
It's a weather-worn gravestone. On closer examination, a faint inscription can be made out...
‘In memory of a loving daughter who risked everything so that her father might live. Rest in peace.’
P-Please, help me<FG> I'm surrounded<FG>
Phew... Thank you<FG> You really saved my skin<FG>
NOT USED
The palace fell to the earth in the north-western reaches of the wilds... Perhaps you will find the portal you seek there...
<F4><I0>00 finds the confiscated weapons<FG>
<F4><I0>01 receives a map to Port-au-Pain<FG>
Good day, <EK>00sir<EL>00milady<EM>00. The monsters of Greena Pastures are making a nuisance of themselves again today. Take care on the road to Harba.
The Grand Dunes lie just beyond this gate. If you're planning on walking all the way to Dunisia, make sure you take plenty of water<FG>
This gate grants access to the Lumberlands<MV>the forest that marks the border between Accordia and the magical kingdom of Ingenia.
Be wary when passing through Redrock Ravine. The monsters there have been known to drop great boulders on travellers' heads<FG>
If you mean to visit Klor, Kadava or Al-Khazam, follow the path north through No Man's Land<MV>and do not stray from it<FG>
The foothills of Mt Neverest lie beyond this gate. I'd wrap up warm if I were you.
The High King awaits you within. Prithee, do not keep His Radiance waiting.
Forgive me, but unless you have some business with His Radiance, I cannot permit you to enter the Pinnacle of Peace.
This gate is closed at present. If you wish to pass, you'll need a special dispensation from the High King.
Beg pardon, but only those with permission from His Radiance may pass this point.
Forgive me, but the lands beyond this gate are currently off limits. Only those with permission from His Radiance may pass this point.
Forgive me, but I cannot allow you through this gate without instructions from the High King.
This gate is closed. Only those with direct permission from the High King may pass this point.
This gate leads to Greena Pastures, and Harba beyond. To get there, you will need to follow the road all the way to the south.
This gate leads to the Grand Dunes, and Dunisia beyond. Follow the road south to reach the city. And do not set out unprepared<FG>
The Lumberlands lie beyond this gate. You will need to follow the path eastward through them if you wish to reach Ingenia.
Redrock Ravine lies beyond this gate. 'Tis a wild frontier of cliffs and canyons, now all but abandoned to the monsters.
This gate leads to No Man's Land, the ravaged border region between Accordia and the three realms of the Beastlands.
This gate leads to the Frosty Foothills. Keep climbing, and you'll reach the summit of Mt Neverest...eventually.
His Radiance is expecting you. Please go on through.
The Pinnacle of Peace is the home of His Radiance, the Supreme Sovereign of the Seven Realms. It isn't open to visitors.
None may pass without the express permission of His Radiance<FG>
Go through this door<FH>
Go through this door<FH>
Go through this door<FH>
Go through this door<FH>
Go through this door<FH>
You hear the sound of a door opening somewhere...
Healix's healing powers have improved<FG> Now he can cast Midheal<FG>
I've got to protect our world... (slurp) I've got to get slooper-dooper strong so I can beat Fractos... I have to<FG>
Goowee<FG> I just got stronger<FG> I can feel it<FG>
Healix's healing powers have improved<FG> Now he can cast Moreheal<FG>
Harba<FG> Stop the advance of the monsters in the centre<FG>
Accordia's so calm and peaceful... (yawn) Makes me feel like taking a nap.
It's great how we keep finding new friends to tag along with us, isn't it<FH>
Mobile strike force<FG> You will join the King of Harba<FG> If we lose the central front, we will be at a grave disadvantage.
Ho ho ho<FG> Brave words, young warrior<FG> But do not charge too blindly into the enemy's midst. We must work together if we are to win.
You must carefully observe the tide of battle, and go where you are needed most. Only by coordinating our actions will we prevail<FG>
Aye, aye, Your Radiance<FG> We'll have them mopped up before you can say ‘monster mush’<FG>
A strange power throbs from the pillar...
The strange pillar is glowing.\nRaise your hand<FH>
Zounds<FG> 'Tis an outrage and a disgrace<FG>
What manner of soldier wouldst comport himself in such a manner<FG><FH>
Eh<FG><FH> That jumped-up guard was a float-o-copier in disguise<FH> 'E got us proper riled up, 'e did<FG> Not that this lot lost much sleep over it...
No... And not just as part of an army, but leading it... Seems like only five minutes ago he was just another Academy wannabe like us...
I know. Back at school, you'd never have guessed he was a prince. The three of us were inseparable, weren't we<FH>
We sure were. Cesar and me inseparably at each other's throats while you tried to pull us apart. Heh...
Thank you, Your Majesty<FG> Alright, everyone, back to Accordia<FG> He can't hide behind that barrier any longer<FG>
(slurp) A barrier<FH> Then fear not<FG> It's slime for me to save the day again<FG> Hooray<FG>
So...it turns out you young whippersnappers are the twins from the prophecy, eh<FH> The descendants of High King Unos...
...We're not going to have to fight him, are we<FH>
Of course not<FG> We're going to go and see the High King and get this all sorted out. It'll never come to that, you'll see<FG>
Yeah... Yeah, you're right. We'll get this whole mess cleared up, and then we can all go back to how we used to be. I can't wait<FG>
Goowee<FG> We're really in Accordia<FG> It's like a dream come true<FG> Look how big and beautiful it is<FG> I'm gooing all wobbly with excitement<FG>
Er, ahem<FG> I mean, stay vigilant, soldiers<FG> Don't forget we're here on a mission<FG>
You know, I've been wondering<MV>why does Healix sometimes talk like that<FH>
Oh, I had this absolute demon of a drill sergeant. I used to always do impressions of him, and Healix got really into it.
So he's copying one of your instructors, is he<FH> Hee hee<FG> Maybe I'll get him to put me through my paces<FG> I need the practice<FG>
Ye, umm... Ye wouldn't mind an auld peddler such as meself taggin' along now, would ye<FH>
You want to come with us<FH>
That I do. I can't just be lookin' out for meself now I know yer world's in trouble, can I<FH> Findin' a way back home can wait<FG>
That's the spirit<FG> Welcome aboard, Pickles<FG> One more royal envoy in our little band won't cause any problems, will it<FH>
The more the merrier, I say<FG> I'll be all the happier knowing I've got a well-rounded team to back me up.
Alriiight<FG> It's decided, then<MV>we're all off to Dunisia<FG>
<F4><S1>, Desdemona and Torneko join the party<FG>
With my guidance, we are unlikely to meet with danger. But we should be prepared nonetheless.
Here we are<FG>
Maya joins the party<FG>
Well, that's our excursion to Ingenia at an end, and another two friends added to our little band. Quite the adventure, eh<FH>
The Queen has already set off for Accordia. We should head there too.
If the High King filled the city with monsters, you can bet he's filled the tower with them too. I hope these ones put up a better fight.
Those two old-timers sure gave us a lotta grief. Whaddya say we go return the favour<FH>
I see great tribulations awaiting us in the Pinnacle of Peace. Be sure that you are ready for anything before we depart.
I can see why the High King would want to live at the very top of that tower. The view from up there must be simply fabulous<FG>
The King of Accordia's pretty much the most famous person in your world, right<FH> Isn't it a little odd that no one knew he had a twin<FH>
<F4><I0>30... I can't stop worrying about the prophecy...
Me neither... Do you really think that<MV>
There you are<FG> A word.
I've remembered something that might help. It's a story about the War of Kings my mother told me when I was a child.
She told me about a jewel Unos used to dispel the darkness that Fractos summoned. It was called the Heart of Brightness...
Of course<FG> Only the day can banish the night<FG> If this jewel held the power of light, surely it could dispel the Cover of Darkness<FG>
Let's not get ahead of ourselves, my dears. I'm not sure precious stones from fairy tales are very easy to come by, you know...
It may not be as outlandish an idea as you think. There is a ruin in Dunisia...the Tomb of the Sun. It is said to have been built by Unos.
It may or may not offer a clue as to the whereabouts of the Heart of Brightness, but it cannot hurt to look.
Interesting... I never knew such a place existed. Well, we don't have anything else to go on<MV>it has to be worth a try.
Premium<FG> Then let us to embark without delay<FG> People of Accordia must not be endured to suffer for any more longer than is essential<FG>
If a damsel in distress were awaiting us at the top of that tower, and not a pair of old fogies, I might be more inclined to climb it...
Sovereign twins peruse us from atop tall tower, yes<FH> Then let us to climb it, and to terminate their imperious perusings<FG>
Aga... Why must we to climb tower of such hair-lifting elevation<FH> My nerves do not combine well with heights... (shiver)
The Queen of Ingenia might know how to bring down that barrier. Come on, let's go and ask her<FG>
The Queen of Ingenia's an expert in all things magical, right<FH> If anyone knows how to dispel that barrier, I bet she will<FG>
Are we gooing back to Ingenia<FH> I hope they don't throw us in the gungeons again...
The battle to retake Dunisia from the monsters is still raging, but with Donk leading the charge, victory is only a matter of time.
His Radiance knows a little magic, but not enough to create a barrier like that. Could this be the work of the Cup of Kings...<FH>
Back to Ingenia, is it<FH> Well, now, that's grand altogether<FG> I was just after thinkin' it'd be nice to revisit me old prison cell, so I was<FG>
That High King's a dirty rotter<FG> He made us traipse all the way to the top of his silly tower, and then all the way back down again<FG>
Hold on<MV>I know this is a bad time to say this, but...I'm really worried about something...
If we try to stop the King<MV>the Kings, I mean<MV>aren't we going against the prophecy<FH>
I've been wondering the same thing<MV>the twin sovereigns are meant to rule, aren't they<FH>
Does fighting them mean that we're fighting how things are meant to be<FH>
We may want to stop the war and save Accordia...but what if we're not supposed to<FH>
Can we really change things<FH> Will anything we do really help anyone in the end<FH>
Hm. How can any of us possibly be certain of that<FH> But I am certain of one thing...
If we do nothing, the Accordians will die, and we will never learn what the High King and his brother are plotting.
It's true. We can't be sure we're doing the right thing...but if there's a chance of saving even one person, we have to fight.
Yeah... Yeah, you're right<FG> We're the only ones who can do this<FG> Alriiight, let's get this show on the road<FG>
Yes<FG> If we don't do it, who else will<FG><FH>
Hm. I see you two are as easily swayed as ever. Good. Then we set out for Dunisia and the Tomb of the Sun right away.
S-Somebody<FG> Help me<FG>
Thank you so much<FG> If you hadn't come along when you did, Goddess knows what would have become of me<FG>
Well, I certainly never thought we'd end up going to the world that Fractos destroyed.
I can't believe it either<MV>it wasn't so long ago we didn't even know it existed<FG> It just doesn't feel real.
Hm. It will feel real enough when we finally get there. Come<MV>to the Tomb of the Sun<FG>
Brave warriors, do you truly wish to risk the journey onward<FH>
Very well. Then I shall pray for your safe arrival in Accordia.
Accordia may be within sight, but complacency begets disaster. You are wise to wait. Only journey onward when you are prepared.
...Here goes<FG>
Hmm... Truly a merciless assault. I fear that our foothold in the centre may be in danger.
We have no choice but to call for reinforcements. Order the Dunisians and Ingenians to deploy the lightmaws<FG>
At once, Sire<FG>
Orders from the High King<FG> Deploy the lightmaws in support of the central front<FG>
Grrrarrrgh<FG> Monsters fight hard<FG> Lightmaw good idea<FG> Deploy<FG> Deploy<FG>
Orders from the High King<FG> Deploy the lightmaws in support of the central front<FG>
At once<FG> Ingenians<FG> Deploy the lightmaws<FG>
Gurr hurr hurr<FG> No more nightmaws in east now<FG> Back to centre<FG> We join Harbans<FG>
We have neutralised the nightmaws to the west<FG> Rejoining the Harbans in the centre<FG>
The pillar gives off a pale glow.
Well, here we are...
